milestones.title: Infrastructure foundation
milestones.objective: Create a reproducible local development environment.
deliverables: Docker Compose services for PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO, Qdrant, and Temporal
FastAPI gateway with health, readiness, and metrics
Prometheus and Grafana observability foundation
acceptance: A developer can deploy the complete stack in under 15 minutes.
milestones.validation: Foundation implementation is delivered. The fresh-clone deployment-time target has not been measured on the target workstation.

milestones.title: AI runtime validation
milestones.objective: Prove local AI inference works on the target Windows 11, WSL2, and Intel Arc workstation.
deliverables: OpenVINO Whisper runtime configuration with Intel Arc GPU access
Local llama.cpp connectivity and runtime diagnostics
Verified GPU and model-backed inference on the target workstation
milestones.validation: Runtime configuration and diagnostics are implemented. Real Whisper inference, llama.cpp generation, and Intel Arc GPU acceleration have not yet been verified.
acceptance: On Windows 11, verify the integrated Ubuntu environment exposes /dev/dxg and /usr/lib/wsl and that Docker Desktop uses its WSL2 backend.
Place a locally converted OpenVINO Whisper model, including .xml/.bin weights and processor/tokenizer files, in ./models/whisper-openvino. Runtime model downloads are not used.
Run docker compose up -d --build; check /runtime and confirm OpenVINO Core lists GPU inside the transcription container.
Confirm the container can reach the Windows-hosted llama.cpp endpoint at http://host.docker.internal:8080/v1/models.
Transcribe a known short media fixture on GPU, compare against a reviewed reference, record latency, then compare with CPU.
Analyze the persisted transcript and confirm ranked moments and job results survive a transcription-service restart.

milestones.title: First video ingestion
deliverables: Local video upload with size and filename checks
ffprobe metadata extraction
MinIO media storage and PostgreSQL video and ingestion-job records
milestones.validation: Ingestion was exercised with a generated MP4; metadata, database records, and object storage were verified.

milestones.title: First transcript
milestones.objective: Transcribe media locally and persist timestamped subtitles.
deliverables: Offline faster-whisper transcription using preinstalled local model weights
Persistent, restart-recoverable transcription jobs
Language metadata, timestamped transcript segments, and downloadable SRT subtitles
milestones.validation: The transcription service and persistence/retrieval paths are implemented and tested with a mocked transcript. Real Whisper inference and transcript accuracy remain unverified.

milestones.title: First AI analysis
milestones.objective: Find compelling moments in a transcript using a local LLM.
deliverables: Timestamp-preserving transcript chunking with overlap
Local llama.cpp moment suggestions with validated JSON and confidence scores
Ranked moment results and durable, restart-recoverable analysis jobs
milestones.validation: Implementation and mocked API/data tests are present. Live llama.cpp generation and the usefulness of the resulting moments have not been validated.

milestones.title: First automated clip
deliverables: Select an analyzed moment and cut source media to its time range
Render a vertical 9:16 clip with captions
Produce a thumbnail for the generated short

milestones.title: First end-to-end video
milestones.objective: Go from local upload to a publish-ready short automatically.
deliverables: Connect ingestion, transcription, moment analysis, clip rendering, captions, and thumbnails
Track and recover end-to-end workflow jobs
Review and export a complete generated short locally

milestones.title: First YouTube publication
milestones.objective: Publish an approved short to YouTube.
deliverables: Optional YouTube account authorization and publishing integration
Explicit review and approval before external publication
Record publication result and remote video reference

milestones.title: First TikTok publication
milestones.objective: Publish an approved short to TikTok.
deliverables: Optional TikTok account authorization and publishing integration
Platform-compatible short metadata and upload flow
Record publication result and remote post reference

milestones.title: First Instagram Reel
milestones.objective: Publish an approved short to Instagram Reels.
deliverables: Optional Instagram account authorization and publishing integration
Platform-compatible reel metadata and upload flow
Record publication result and remote reel reference

milestones.title: Autonomous content factory
milestones.objective: Coordinate content production through local agent-driven workflows.
deliverables: Automate repeatable production steps with observable, recoverable workflows
Keep human approval at configured review and publishing boundaries
Integrate future MCP and Hermes agent surfaces where appropriate

milestones.title: First dollar earned
deliverables: Define a measurable revenue experiment
Record attributable revenue and operating costs

milestones.title: First $100
deliverables: Reach $100 in tracked revenue
Document repeatability and associated operating costs

milestones.title: First $1,000
milestones.objective: Prove commercial viability with sustained results.
deliverables: Reach $1,000 in tracked revenue
Measure repeatability, platform performance, and operating costs

milestones.title: Open-source community release
milestones.objective: Launch a usable, documented release for the wider community.
deliverables: Publish contributor, security, and deployment documentation
Provide a tested release process and supported setup guidance
Welcome community contributions and issue reports
